Delete Ec Vm By Instance ID
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecVm/uuid/:vmInstanceId

Deletes a VM based on the provided Cloud or Branch Connector native public cloud instance ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
vmInstanceId
string
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM native public cloud instance.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
